definitions.gloss: in great numbers; aplenty; by the thousand
definitions.explanation: In very large numbers, more than enough. Informal; usually with ある or いる.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ごまんと⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ごまんと⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are loads of people like that.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、⟦{世|よ}の{中|なか}→世の中：03666_yononaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ごまんと⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: There are countless young people out there with more talent than him.

notes:
From ⟦{五万|ごまん}→五万：30468_goman⟧ "fifty thousand" used loosely for a huge number, + ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧. It often carries the sense "so many that they are nothing special".

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ごまんと⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there are tons of (things)
- 〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ごまんと⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: there are tons of (people)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧: a lot; neutral
- {山|やま}ほど: a mountain of, loads
